market_position.positioning_summary: Diwan Realty is a boutique real estate consultancy in Gurgaon specializing exclusively in luxury and ultra-luxury residential properties on Golf Course Road and Golf Course Extension Road. The brand is perceived as a professional, client-first agency in an otherwise unorganized market. Led by founder Sachin Diwan, it has built a strong local reputation based on trust and personalized service.
differentiators: Exclusive focus on premium Gurgaon micro-markets (Golf Course Road & Golf Course Extension Road) with deep inventory knowledge
Founder-led, high-touch service model praised for professionalism and transparency in a chaotic market
risks_or_weaknesses: Very small review base (only 6 Google reviews), limiting social proof at scale
No proprietary projects; entirely dependent on third-party developer inventory (DLF, M3M, IREO, etc.)

key_trends: Demand for ultra-luxury units (₹5 Cr+) in Gurgaon's Golf Course Road corridor has surged post-pandemic, driven by HNI and NRI buyers
Digital-first property discovery via Instagram Reels and YouTube walkthroughs is becoming the primary lead generation channel for luxury brokers
WhatsApp-based nurturing and CRM tools are replacing cold calling for premium segment follow-ups
Video tours and drone footage of luxury projects significantly improve qualified lead conversion for boutique agencies

comparison_to_competitor.summary: Sotheby's International Realty commands global brand recognition and targets the same ultra-luxury Gurgaon segment with a significantly stronger digital and content marketing presence. Diwan Realty offers more personalized, founder-led service but lacks the international credibility and marketing scale of branded competitors. In terms of website quality, Sotheby's is more polished, though Diwan Realty's site is functional and well-organized for its niche.
notes: Competitors like Sotheby's and Square Yards invest heavily in SEO, video content, and paid digital — areas where Diwan Realty appears underinvested
Diwan Realty's hyper-local focus and personal trust factor can be a competitive moat that larger platforms cannot easily replicate
